meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 当用户上传基因表达数据（如RNA-seq表格）时，Claude会用arboreto推断基因调控网络，输出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系列表（包含重要性得分）。
howto.when: 当用户提到需要分析转录组数据（如bulk RNA-seq、单细胞RNA-seq）、推断基因调控网络，或要求使用GRNBoost2、GENIE3等算法时触发。

say.text: 帮我用GRNBoost2分析这个单细胞RNA-seq数据，找出关键转录因子。
say.note: Claude将运行GRNBoost2算法并输出调控网络。

say.text: 使用arboreto从我的bulk RNA-seq数据中推断基因调控网络。
say.note: Claude将读取数据并返回TF-target关系表。

say.text: 对三个不同条件的表达数据分别做网络推断并比较结果。
say.note: Claude将循环处理每个条件并输出多个网络文件。

howto.what_en: When a user provides gene expression data (e.g., RNA-seq tables), Claude uses arboreto to infer gene regulatory networks, outputting a list of transcription factor–target gene relationships with importance scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions analyzing transcriptomic data (e.g., bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq), inferring gene regulatory networks, or requesting algorithms like GRNBoost2 or GENIE3.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on this single-cell RNA-seq data to find key transcription factors.
say_en.note: Claude will execute GRNBoost2 and output the regulatory network.

say_en.text: Use arboreto to infer a gene regulatory network from my bulk RNA-seq data.
say_en.note: Claude will read the data and return a TF-target relationship table.

say_en.text: Run network inference separately for three conditions and compare.
say_en.note: Claude will loop through each condition and output multiple network files.
